chatPreferences.headerDescription: Organization-wide chat settings and defaults. Users can override some of these in their personal settings.
chatPreferences.searchModeDescription: UI mode for quick document search across your organization.
chatPreferences.searchModeEnterpriseTooltip: Search Mode is an Enterprise Plan feature.
chatPreferences.searchModeNeedConnectors: Set up connectors to use Search Mode
chatPreferences.multiModelGenerationDescription: Allow multiple models to generate responses in parallel in chat.
chatPreferences.deepResearchDescription: Agentic research system that works across the web and connected sources. Uses significantly more tokens per query.
chatPreferences.chatAutoScrollDescription: Automatically scroll to new content as chat generates response. Users can override this in their personal settings.
chatPreferences.teamNameDescription: This is added to all chat sessions as additional context to provide a richer/customized experience.
chatPreferences.teamContextDescription: Users can also provide additional individual context in their personal settings.
chatPreferences.teamContextPlaceholder: Describe your team and how Onyx should behave.
chatPreferences.systemPromptDescription: Base prompt for all chats, agents, and projects. Modify with caution: Significant changes may degrade response quality.
chatPreferences.actionsToolsDescription: Tools and capabilities available for chat to use. This does not apply to agents.
chatPreferences.internalSearchDescription: Search through your organization's connected knowledge base and documents.
chatPreferences.imageGenerationDescription: Generate and manipulate images using AI-powered tools.
chatPreferences.imageGenerationDisabledTooltip: Image generation requires a configured model. Set one up under Configuration > Image Generation, or ask an admin.
chatPreferences.webSearchDescription: Search the web for real-time information and up-to-date results.
chatPreferences.openUrlDescription: Fetch and read content from web URLs.
chatPreferences.mcpAuthTooltip: Authenticate this MCP server before enabling its tools.
chatPreferences.keepChatHistoryDescription: Specify how long Onyx should retain chats in your organization.
chatPreferences.keepChatHistoryEnterpriseTooltip: Chat history retention is an Enterprise Plan feature.
chatPreferences.queryHistoryVisibilityDescription: Control how your organization's full chat history appears in the Admin Panel.
chatPreferences.queryHistoryNormalDescription: All queries are visible to admins and linked to individual users.
chatPreferences.queryHistoryAnonymizedDescription: Queries are visible to admins with user identity removed
chatPreferences.fileAttachmentSizeLimitDescription: Files attached in chats and projects must fit within both limits to be accepted. Larger files increase latency, memory usage, and token costs.
chatPreferences.imageExtractionDescription: Extract embedded images from uploaded files (PDFs, DOCX, etc.) and summarize them with a vision-capable LLM so image-only documents become searchable and answerable. Requires a vision-capable default LLM.
chatPreferences.allowAnonymousUsersDescription: Allow anyone to start chats without logging in. They do not see any other chats and cannot create agents or update settings.
chatPreferences.alwaysStartWithAgentDescription: This removes the default chat. Users will always start in an agent, and new chats will be created in their last active agent. Set featured agents to help new users get started.
chatPreferences.systemPromptModalDescription: This base prompt is prepended to all chats, agents, and projects.
chatPreferences.systemPromptPlaceholdersHelp:
You can use the following placeholders in your prompt:
`'{{'CURRENT_DATETIME'}}'` - Current date and day of the week in a human-readable format.
`'{{'CITATION_GUIDANCE'}}'` - Instructions for providing citations when facts are retrieved from search tools.
Only included when search tools are used.
`'{{'REMINDER_TAG_DESCRIPTION'}}'` - Instructions for how to interpret system reminders in user messages.
chatPreferences.modifyWithCautionDescription: System prompt affects all chats, agents, and projects. Significant changes may degrade response quality.

upgrading.cancelModalBody: Are you sure you want to cancel? Cancelling will revert to the previous model and all progress will be lost.
upgrading.switchingTo: Currently in the process of switching to: {model}
upgrading.instantBody: You're currently switching embedding models, and you've selected the instant switch option. The transition will complete shortly.
upgrading.newModelActiveSoon: The new model will be active soon.
upgrading.noConnectorsBody: You're currently switching embedding models, but there are no connectors to reindex. This means the transition will be quick and seamless!
upgrading.progressActiveOnly:
The table below shows the re-indexing progress of active (non-paused) connectors. Once all active connectors have been re-indexed successfully, the new model will be used for all search queries. Paused connectors will continue to be indexed in the background but won't block the switchover. Until then, we will use the old model so that no downtime is necessary during this transition.
Note: User file re-indexing progress is not shown. You will see this page until all active connectors are re-indexed!
upgrading.progressAllConnectors:
The table below shows the re-indexing progress of all existing connectors. Once all connectors have been re-indexed successfully, the new model will be used for all search queries. Until then, we will use the old model so that no downtime is necessary during this transition.
Note: User file re-indexing progress is not shown. You will see this page until all user files are re-indexed!
upgrading.allPaused: All connectors are currently paused, so none are blocking the switchover. Paused connectors will keep re-indexing in the background.
